newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pernod Ricard buys Ricqles soft drink.
newsitem.headline: Pernod Ricard buys Ricqles soft drink.

text.p: French beverage group Pernod Ricard SA has agreed to buy the Ricqles soft drink from Perrier Vittel of the Nestle group for an undisclosed amount, the companies said in a joint statement.
The transaction will be effective on January 1, 1997.
Mint-flavoured Ricqles will be bottled and marketed by Orangina France, part of the Pernod Ricard group.
Ricqles has an annual turnover of 10 million francs ($1.9 million) and Orangina of some two billion francs.
